result.rationale: Adult with a low-energy ankle inversion injury, mild lateral soreness and small swelling, no deformity, numbness, wound, or heard crack; reports no malleolar or midfoot bony tenderness and could take four steps immediately and now, so no Ottawa imaging criteria are met. Home care (protection, rest, ice, compression, elevation, gradual movement) is appropriate, with escalation if pain/swelling worsens, weight-bearing becomes impossible, or there is no improvement.
